supported_text: A price-feed check must validate the canonical account alongside the feed ID. Otherwise an attacker can submit a historical valid price from a custom account within the accepted age window.
unsupported_text: Non-canonical price feeds cause more smart contract losses than every other bug class combined.
note: The unsupported ranking is deliberately invented test content, never production evidence.
